reason: The already-authorized PIL V4 candidate did not match the frozen AUTOSAR V20 provider protocol. It used Responses API, medium reasoning, a 4096 output-token cap, a 120-second timeout, and no transmitted replicate seeds. The mismatch was detected before any provider call; the candidate was therefore superseded rather than executed or edited in place.
replacement_rule: Only a separately generated, separately authorized schedule whose preflight includes PIL_V4_AUTOSAR_V20_PARAMETER_MATCH.json may be executed.
